name: deepseek-code-agent
description: Delegate coding work to a stateful DeepSeek agent while Codex remains the controller and reviewer.

interface.shortDescription: Let DeepSeek implement code while Codex controls and reviews.
interface.longDescription: Adds a stateful DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Max coding worker with scoped AGENTS/rule manifests, persistent sessions, queued follow-ups, status waiting, context forks, permission handling, diffs, and Codex review guidance for coding goals.
defaultPrompt: Use DeepSeek to implement this coding goal, then review and verify its patch.
Delegate the implementation to DeepSeek and keep control of corrections.
Inspect the current DeepSeek coding agent and review its diff.
